TenantStats.description: Live chat/thread counts per assistant and per agent for a tenant (from the indexed tenantId, so they reflect full history).

LimitRule.description: A usage-limit rule. scope=tenant caps the whole tenant; scope=subtenant with no id applies the same cap to EACH subtenant; scope=subtenant with subtenantId overrides one subtenant. The window is windowEvery x windowUnit.

windowEvery.description: Number of windowUnit per window (e.g. 3 hours)

RuleUsage.description: Live consumption for one applicable rule.

resetsAt.description: Epoch ms when the window resets

subtenantId.description: Present only on the subtenant variant

Tier.description: A reusable bundle of limit rules (a plan, e.g. free/pro/enterprise). Tenants reference a tier by tierId by live reference: editing the tier applies instantly to every tenant assigned to it.

excludedAssistants.description: Assistants exempt from this tier's limits (by specialization identifier or _id) — neither counted nor blocked

excludedAgents.description: Agents exempt from this tier's limits (by _id)

isDefault.description: Applied to tenants without an explicit tierId

TenantUsageHistoryRow.description: Durable snapshot of one closed usage window (the live counters are ephemeral).

exemptConsumption.description: Amount incurred by exempt entities (not counted toward the limit)

reason.description: Free-text reason stored in the tier-change audit log

resetUsage.description: Also reset usage counters on change

message.description: The user message to append to the thread to continue it (string or object). Behaviour depends on the current thread state: a running/queued thread receives it on its next turn (after the pending tool response); a completed/failed/waiting thread is re-queued to run again with the message appended.
message.example: Also include a summary of the previous steps

default.description: Prefilled value, when the provider suggests one

secret.description: Holds a credential: mask it on screen and keep it out of logs

mode.description: The provider's own name for it

composioManaged.description: The integration provider holds credentials for this app, so `appCredentials` can be omitted. False for most of the catalog

redirect.description: Connecting returns an authorizationUrl to open in a browser

appFields.description: Credentials of your own application with the provider, registered once for the workspace. Empty when composioManaged

accountFields.description: What the account being connected supplies: its API key, its subdomain

authScheme.description: Which scheme to connect through, from GET /integrations/:app/auth. Defaults to the one asking for least setup

appCredentials.description: Credentials of your own application with the provider, keyed by the scheme's appFields. Needed once per workspace for apps the integration provider holds no credentials for; ignored afterwards

accountFields.description: What this account supplies, keyed by the scheme's accountFields — an API key, the subdomain of your instance

connected.description: True when the account is connected already — API-key apps have nothing to authorise, so no browser is involved

authorizationUrl.description: Open this URL in a browser to authorise the account. Absent when connected is already true

authScheme.description: Which scheme to connect through, from GET /:app/auth

accountFields.description: What this account supplies, keyed by the scheme's accountFields

id.description: Integration id (use it for tools management)

exposedToolCount.description: How many tools it exposes. Absent means all of the app’s.

name.description: Tool server name. Defaults to the app name.

tools.description: Tool slugs to expose. Empty or omitted exposes every tool the app has (a large prompt — narrowing is recommended).

toolServerId.description: The app-integration tool server whose events this listens to

agentId.description: Agent to start. Exactly one of agentId / assistantId is required.

assistantId.description: Assistant to start. Exactly one of agentId / assistantId is required.

triggerConfig.description: Values for the trigger type's config JSON Schema

messageTemplate.description: Template rendering the event into the message. Empty ⇒ raw event JSON.

versionCreated.description: Only present on update responses. True when the update changed the content and created a new version; false when the update was a no-op or only touched metadata.

isSkill.description: True when the document is a skill

tags.description: Category tags

schemes.description: The ways this app can be connected. Empty when it needs no account at all

connected.description: Whether an active account for this app exists on the workspace

slug.description: App slug — the key to connect it

noAuth.description: True when the app needs no user connection

nextCursor.description: Token for the next page, when more exist

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call being responded to

content.description: The result of the tool execution

messageUid.description: Unique id of the matching message within the conversation

partType.description: Type of the matching message part

name.description: Skill name. Also names the folder.

description.description: One-line description. It is what the model sees before deciding to load the skill, so phrase it as a trigger ("How to … when …"). Newlines are collapsed; truncated to 1024 characters in the catalog.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to scope the skill

tags.description: Category tags

folder.description: The created folder, flagged as a skill. Its `_id` is what goes into `knowledgeSkills` with `type: "folder"`.

skillDoc.description: The generated SKILL.md manifest document inside the folder

name.description: From the SKILL.md frontmatter, or the document/folder name

description.description: From the SKILL.md frontmatter, or the summary. Truncated to 1024 chars.

tags.description: Category tags

projectId.description: Project ID, when the skill is scoped

readCount.description: Times the knowledge tools read this skill

linkedAgentsCount.description: Agents linking this skill. Only returned when `limit` is set.

linkedAssistantsCount.description: Assistants linking this skill. Only returned when `limit` is set.

installCount.description: Active CLI installs. Only returned when `limit` is set.

github.description: Present when the folder-skill is connected to a GitHub repo folder (read-only, materialised live)

limit.description: Page size. When the request omits `limit`, the whole catalog is returned in one page and this equals `total` — usage stats are omitted in that case because they are computed per page.

messageId.description: The unique message ID (uid) to submit feedback for

feedback.description: Feedback value: true = positive, false = negative

parameters.description: Arguments passed to the tool, as the app expects them. Omit for a tool that takes none.

success.description: Whether the app accepted and ran the call

data.description: What the tool returned, exactly as the agent would receive it

error.description: Why it failed, in the app’s own words

requiresUserAction.description: True when the failure is the connection itself (expired or revoked account), not the arguments

executionTimeMs.description: Round trip to the app, in milliseconds

requestId.description: Message ID the feedback is for

tokenUsage.description: Enhanced token usage with cost breakdown

metadata.description: Thread metadata containing prompt template parameters and tenant token

propmptTemplateParams.description: Parameters used for template variable substitution in the agent system prompt (e.g., {{customerName}} becomes "John Doe")

tenantToken.description: Token used for authentication in tool calling operations

isSubthread.description: Whether this thread is a subthread created by a parent handoff

parentThreadId.description: ID of the parent thread (if this is a subthread)

parentAgentId.description: ID of the parent agent (if this is a subthread)

subThreadToolCallId.description: Tool call ID in the parent thread that triggered this subthread

pendingHandOffSubThreadIds.description: IDs of subthreads still executing (for parent threads)

handOffSubThreadIds.description: All subthread IDs ever created during handoffs (for parent threads)

tasks.description: List of task for the thread execution

pendingAsyncToolCalls.description: Pending async tool calls awaiting an external response. Each entry exposes the callbackUrl the external system must POST the response to.

pausedReason.description: Reason the thread is paused (e.g. waiting for an async tool response).

pausedUntil.description: Epoch milliseconds when a paused thread is scheduled to resume. Only set while the thread is paused with a scheduled resume.

pausedTimestampMS.description: Epoch milliseconds when the thread was paused.

coreMemories.description: Audit trail of the core-memory blocks this thread saw: one snapshot (render revision + the injected entries as structured JSON) per distinct revision, including mid-run edits. Present only for agents with core memory enabled.

recalledMemories.description: Structured recall events of this thread: the automatic long-term-memory recall at run start plus every memory-tool lookup, each with the query and the facts/entities it surfaced. Present only for agents with long-term memory enabled.

slug.description: Trigger slug — the key to create a trigger

type.description: `poll` events arrive minutes late; `webhook` events arrive at once

instructions.description: Provider setup notes for the end user

config.description: JSON Schema of the trigger settings — what to send as triggerConfig

payload.description: JSON Schema of the event body — the fields a message template can reference

section.description: Move the entry to another section

enable.description: Tool slugs to start exposing (added to the current selection)

disable.description: Tool slugs to stop exposing (removed from the current selection)

all.description: Expose every tool the app has (clears any explicit selection)

transcriptId.description: Public identifier of the transcript. Send it back as `transcriptId` when posting the message so the conversation keeps a link to the audio.

audioUrl.description: Download URL of the source audio.

McpGatewayProfile.description: A named set of tools hidden from whoever is assigned the profile.

hiddenToolNames.description: Tools that stay invisible to the users of this profile

profileId.description: Visibility profile assigned to the user

userHiddenToolNames.description: Extra tools hidden for this user, on top of the profile

profileId.description: Profile to assign, or null to clear it

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime in seconds. Clamped into range, never rejected.

token.description: Send it as the bearer token from the browser

post.description:
Mints a short-lived token that **proves** which end user is calling, instead of trusting what the page claims. Your backend asks for it with a server-side API key and hands it to the browser; from then on the widget calls Devic with the session token and the tenant can no longer be forged.

Two rules keep the guarantee honest, and both are enforced:

- A session cannot issue another session. An expiry that the holder can extend is not an expiry.
- The call must come from a server. A request carrying an `Origin` header, or made with a key configured for browser domains, is refused — a session minted with a key that ships in a bundle would prove nothing.

`ttlSeconds` is clamped into the allowed range rather than rejected: ask for a year and you get twelve hours.

**Note the path.** This is the one public endpoint served by the gateway itself rather than proxied, so it is reached at `/api/v1/tenant-sessions` — the `/api` prefix that the rest of the API accepts optionally is required here.

400.description: tenantId missing, or ttlSeconds is not a number

403.description: Issued from a browser, or by another tenant session
